APPOINTMENT OF AUTHORIZED OFFICERS UNDER THE PRIVATE MEDICAL INSTITUTIONS(REGISTRATION) ACT, No. 21 OF 2006

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Sub section 4 of the Section 14 of the Private Medical Institutions (Registration)Act, No. 21 of 2006, I, Dr. Rajitha Senarathna, Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine do by thisNotification, appoint the following Officers mentioned in the Schedule hereto shall be the Authorized Officers for thepurpose of the said Act in respect of the area assigned to them in the Schedule and in any other area in respect to whichthey may be appointed to act on the exigencies of services. They are appointed by virtue of their ex officio status and thiswill cover the existing officers in the Schedule hereto who are holding such posts as well as officers who will be appointedto such posts from time to time.
DR. RAJITHA SENARATHNA,Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine.
